sentences: Keep the actual size the same and make the image size larger, then smaller.
title: How much is a cell magnified?
goal: Find the magnification from the size of a drawing and the size of the cell.
note: Magnification tells you how many times bigger the drawing or image is than the real specimen: magnification = image size / actual size.

predict.prompt: If you make the drawing twice as big but keep the cell the same size, what happens to the magnification?
predict.reveal: Try an image size of 20 mm and then 40 mm with the actual size fixed.

hints: Magnification compares the size of the picture with the real size.
Which size goes on top of the fraction, the drawing or the real cell?
Check that both sizes are in the same unit before you divide.
